title: henckelia ramosa
intro: Henckelia ramosa, commonly known as Ramshorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia ramosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which may help to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Henckelia ramosa on human health.
